author: pinkyiamrate
quote: 13 years, over a billion budget, 2 delays and Gta 6 disappoints. Storyline is bland, characters arent deep enough, features that make grand theft auto are removed, cant hurt certain npcs, cant steal some cars, slowburner would be a compliment, why am i unclogging a sink for someone, 30 fps(if you are lucky), a lot of fps drops that feels like a slideshow, no pc release and of course a lot of bugs(cyberpunk got crucified for this). A game this big shouldnt have bugs and we were told it was delayed to "polish" what a joke and waste of 80 bucks and time waiting for this. Atleast the graphics and some easter eggs are good.  Also idk how people say this game is "game of the year" no buggy mess that took 13 years and 2 delays should be goty. Also jasons voice is terrible aint no way. Overall 6.8/10 if you consider the budget, the wait time and the delays 2.4/10
